description: Step 2 of fz-sc8.192 (page v2). Put and delete on a trie copy the nodes on one path; a flat map grows into a trie at 33 entries and a trie shrinks to the flat array at 32; collision nodes; %{m | k: v} on a trie updates a path. Signal: a fixture pins bytes allocated by 10,000 puts (Process.heap_alloc_stats); the spike table re-measured in the real runtime (spike at 100,000 integer keys: build 149 ns per put, hit 35 ns, 586 bytes per put); the distiller re-timed and re-profiled, prediction: map put under 3% of samples; collector cost of many small nodes measured on the distiller. Removes the O(n^2) statements in lib/map.fz, .agent/docs/any-value.md, .agent/docs.md, guides/memory.html, and the spike worktree fz-maps-spike.
title: A put into a large map copies a path of the hash tree
